shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && echo '--- src ---' && find src -maxdepth 3 -type f -print -exec sh -c 'echo \"### "'$1"; sed -n "1,220p" "$1"'"' _ {} \\;"
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json && echo '--- files ---' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort | head -200"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/index.d.ts && echo '=== helpers ===' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/helpers.d.ts && echo '=== common typings ===' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/common.d.ts && echo '=== config typings ===' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/config.d.ts && echo '=== plugin typings ===' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/plugin.d.ts && echo '=== components index ===' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/index.d.ts && echo '=== shared types ===' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/index.d.ts && echo '=== shared types file ===' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared -type f -name '*.d.ts' -exec sh -c 'echo \"### "'$1"; cat "$1"'"' _ {} \\;"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'NO INDEX.md' && echo '=== DashKit.js ===' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.js 2>/dev/null || echo 'NO DashKit.js' && echo '=== DashKit.d.ts ===' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build -name 'DashKit.d.ts' -exec cat {} \\;"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"pluginTitle|pluginText\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/index.js | head -20 && echo '=== built-in plugin exports ===' && rg \"export\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/index.d.ts && echo '===' && rg -n \"export\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/index.d.ts && echo '===' && rg \"export\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/helpers.d.ts && echo '===' && rg \"export\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/index.js | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts && echo '=== ActionPanel.d.ts ===' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.d.ts && echo '=== ActionPanel types ===' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel -name 'types.d.ts' -exec cat {} \\; && echo '=== plugins index.d.ts ===' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/Title.d.ts && echo '=== Text.d.ts ===' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Text/Text.d.ts && echo '=== pluginTitle.js top ===' && sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/Title.js && echo '=== pluginText.js top ===' && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Text/Text.js"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>/dev/null && echo '---' && node -e \"const p = require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json'); console.log(p.version, Object.keys(p.exports||{}).slice(0,20))\" 2>/dev/null || echo 'No @gravity-ui/icons installed'"
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && echo '--- icon index exports sample ---' && grep -E \"Chart|Circle|Text|Gauge|Table|Database|List|Metric\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Table\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -40; echo '---'; rg -n \"Grid\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -40; echo '---'; rg -n \"Cells|Sheet|Layout\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/App.tsx')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace(\"import { ChartColumn } from '@gravity-ui/icons';\\nimport { Gauge } from '@gravity-ui/icons';\\nimport { Table } from '@gravity-ui/icons';\\nimport { ListUl } from '@gravity-ui/icons';\\nimport { SquareChartBar } from '@gravity-ui/icons';\", \"import { ChartColumn } from '@gravity-ui/icons';\\nimport { Speedometer } from '@gravity-ui/icons';\\nimport { LayoutCells } from '@gravity-ui/icons';\\nimport { ListUl } from '@gravity-ui/icons';\\nimport { SquareChartBar } from '@gravity-ui/icons';\")
s=s.replace(\"const metricIcon = <Icon data={Gauge} />;\", \"const metricIcon = <Icon data={Speedometer} />;\")
s=s.replace(\"const tableIcon = <Icon data={Table} />;\", \"const tableIcon = <Icon data={LayoutCells} />;\")
s=s.replace(\"          {data.delta && (\\n            <Text variant=\\\"body-1\\\" color=\\\"secondary\\\">\\n              {String(data.delta)}\\n            </Text>\\n          )}\", \"          {Boolean(data.delta) && (\\n            <Text variant=\\\"body-1\\\" color=\\\"secondary\\\">\\n              {String(data.delta)}\\n            </Text>\\n          )}\")
p.write_text(s)
print('patched')
PY
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1"
